title: Vulgar's pvp bot
description:
It adds commands like

/pb spawn PlayerName
/pb attack

In early stages, so expect bugs
body: # Vulgar's PvP Bot A PvP practice bot for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric)** featuring realistic combat mechanics and randomized fighting behavior > ⚠️ This project is **not a port of PvPBot**. It was developed completely from scratch without using their source code. --- ## Features ✅ Sprint-hit combos ✅ Strafing movement ✅ Random critical hits ✅ Randomized combat patterns ✅ Player targeting commands ✅ Active development 🟡 Mace PvP (Being Worked On) --- ## Commands `/pb spawn ` Spawns a PvP bot with the specified name `/pb attack ` Makes the bot attack a player --- ## Combat AI The bot attempts to behave more like a real PvP player instead of attacking in a predictable pattern Current behavior includes: - Sprint resetting - Strafing - Combo initiation - Random critical hits - Randomized decision making Because of this, fights feel less scripted and are better for practice. --- ## Roadmap - More fighting styles - Smarter movement - Better pathfinding - Additional commands - More customization --- ## Why Choose Vulgar's PvP Bot? Unlike simple practice bots, this bot randomizes its combat decisions instead of repeating the same attack sequence every fight, making practice sessions feel more natural. --- This mod is actively maintained. Expect regular updates, bug fixes, and new combat improvements Oh and also join the discord if ya want to report bugs or got suggestions Thanks for checking the mod out ❤️
